title: Crimean–Circassian war (1552–1556)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Crimean–Circassian war (1552–1556)", at revision 1376210133, opens: "The Crimean-Circassian War of 1552–1556 was a military conflict between the Crimean Khanate and the Kabardian Principality." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q111940778, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1551–1556 war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
